subject.title: Feature request: Auto-send intent/acknowledgment text message before agent processing

question: Should OpenClaw add a generic cross-channel acknowledgement-text contract, use channel-specific placeholder issues as the canonical path, or decline text acknowledgements in favor of reactions and typing indicators?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix adds new user-visible config/API surface and overlaps several channel-specific placeholder proposals, so maintainer product intent is required before implementation.

options.title: Approve Generic Ack Text
options.body: Add a default-off `messages.ackText`-style config or documented send-and-continue hook with scope and per-channel/account overrides.

options.title: Use Channel-Specific Placeholders
options.body: Keep this issue as context and let Slack, Telegram, Discord, and other channel-specific placeholder issues define their own native lifecycle semantics.

options.title: Decline Text Acks
options.body: Standardize on typing indicators, ack reactions, and status reactions, then close or redirect text-ack requests to those supported cues.

recommendation.title: Approve Generic Ack Text
recommendation.body: Add a default-off `messages.ackText`-style config or documented send-and-continue hook with scope and per-channel/account overrides.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined history across acknowledgement cleanup, Slack responsiveness work, and the prior review of this issue.
